query: Economist/YouGov poll congressional ballot Democrat Republican margin

results.content:
A survey from YouGov/Economist released on Tuesday shows that in a generic congressional vote, 36 percent of U.S. adults would pick the Democratic candidate compared to 31 percent who would pick the Republican candidate. One percent said other, eight percent said not sure and 23 percent said they would not vote.

The poll surveyed 1,592 U.S. adults from August 28-31 and had a margin of error of 3.5 percent. Trump's slightly improving approval rating comes as the GOP continues to struggle against the Democrats in a generic congressional ballot. According to the newest poll, Democrats continue to hold an advantage of 6 percentage points over Republicans ahead of November’s midterm elections.

Tuesday’s The Economist/YouGov poll was conducted Aug. 21-24 among 1,536 U.S. adults. The poll's margin of error was plus or minus 3.5 percentage points.
